messages:
ryan_support: FYI — customer ACME (ticket #3182) reports invoice generator output changed after last weekend's rollout. Small reorder in their template now produces garbage line items. They shared before vs after and repro steps below. Please triage :face_with_head_bandage:

samira_eng: can you paste the exact template they used and a minimal example request?

ryan_support: pasted below. customer says it worked before rollout on Fri. They sent this minimal prompt/template: 

```
template: "Invoice for ${CUSTOMER}\nItems:\n- ${QTY} x ${PRODUCT} — ${PRICE}\nTotal: ${TOTAL}"
input: { CUSTOMER: "Acme, Inc.", QTY: 3, PRODUCT: "Widget A", PRICE: "$12.00", TOTAL: "$36.00" }
```

Before rollout (model v1.14):
"Invoice for Acme, Inc.\nItems:\n- 3 x Widget A — $12.00\nTotal: $36.00"

After rollout (model v1.15-canary):
"Invoice for Acme, Inc.\nItems:\n- 3 x Widget A — $12.00\nTotal: $\n- Widget A x3"

ryan_support: customer says tiny reorder of placeholders (moved `${TOTAL}` above items) also changes behavior unpredictably.

samira_eng: :eyes: looks like a template-sensitivity regression. Did the rollout change model family or tokenization/quantization config?

matt_devops: deploy-bot reports a model variant swap during rollout window: v1.14 -> v1.15 (opt-quant-8) for cheaper Dedicated capacity. I have the deploy log: `deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-14T02:11Z model=v1.15 variant=opt-quant-8 traffic=100%`

samira_eng: thanks. opt-quant-8 -> possible quantization-induced tokenization boundary changes or attention kernel differences. Can we repro locally with the same variant and quant settings?

matt_devops: reproducer script run on our staging infra (same variant) produced the broken output. Quick log excerpt: `kv_cache: enabled; batch=1; seq_in=64; kernel=attn_v2; tokens_out: 18`

samira_eng: interesting — sample shows duplication and dropped numeric formatting. Could be special-casing for `$` token or placeholder ordering interacting with tokenizer splits. Try forcing `preserve_placeholders=true` or escaping `$` as `\$` in prompt to confirm.

ryan_support: customer tried escaping and said it made output slightly better but still inconsistent. They need a hotfix or rollback — they have revenue-critical invoices.

samira_eng: Proposed immediate steps: 1) rollback traffic to v1.14 for this customer (or all Dedicated tenants using opt-quant-8) 2) create minimal unit test covering placeholder reorder combos 3) investigate quantization/tokenizer mapping diffs between v1.14 and v1.15.

matt_devops: I can rollback canary to v1.14 for Dedicated pool `dedicated-us-west-2-03`. On it now. /deploy rollback --target=dedicated-us-west-2-03 --model=v1.14  

deploy-bot: rollback started by matt_devops at 2026-03-14T03:05Z. previous traffic snapshot saved id=rb-2168709-3.

samira_eng: while rollback runs, can you attach the minimal reproducible requests (raw HTTP calls including `model: "v1.15"` header) to a GH issue? I want to run a token-level diff: tokenization + logits for the region where output diverges.

ryan_support: added a link to the ticket with full request/response and a recording of the customer's session (they redacted PII). Ticket: https://acme.support/3182 (internal link).

samira_eng: thanks. Also please check if any routing policy changed — sometimes we fall back to a different decoder kernel under load and that can reveal edge cases.

matt_devops: rollback completed at 2026-03-14T03:12Z. deploy-bot: rollback finished id=rb-2168709-3 traffic->v1.14 :thumbsup:

ryan_support: I informed ACME that we've rolled them back to v1.14 and engineering is investigating; they're testing now. Will update SLA/incident if they confirm.

samira_eng: next steps for eng: - reproduce failure with a deterministic harness (same tokenizer + quant config) - capture tokenized sequences and compare tokens surrounding `$` and placeholder names - run logits diff and sampling RNG seed to see if greedy vs sampling changes behaviour - add prompt-sensitivity unit test to prevent regressions

matt_devops: noted. Also will add a temporary rollout-policy gate to prevent opt-quant-8 from going GA without prompt-sensitivity smoke tests.

ryan_support: ACME confirmed after rollback their invoices look normal again. :relieved: They asked for ETA on permanent fix.

samira_eng: ETA: I need 24–48h to triage and produce a minimal patch or adjusted quant config; will update GH issue with findings. If root cause is quantization token mapping, fix may require re-quant + small retrain or alternatively a tokenizer alias patch to preserve `$` as a single token in problematic locales.

matt_devops: tagging `deploy-safety` to add a rollout checklist: include placeholder smoke test for common billing templates.

ryan_support: thanks team. I'll keep customer updated and escalate to CSM if they press for faster SLA credits. :+1:

samira_eng: will post findings here once I have token diffs. If anyone sees similar thread from other customers, tag me @samira_eng.

matt_devops: FYI creating an alert to track any spike in template-related support tickets after rollouts.

ryan_support: closing loop for now. Reopen if ACME sees anything else.
